messages:
liya: starting a controlled canary for v3.2.2 (embed + routing) in 4m within the 23:00-01:00 change window. i'll watch p95/p99 + 5xx + kvcache.

rory: noted. release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v3.2.2. i'll standby for alerts and traces.

dev-bot: deploy initiated service=embed-service env=prod stage=canary version=v3.2.2 target=8% traffic hosts=[h1,h2]

jen: quick thresholds: p95 <= 130ms soft, p99 <= 320ms, 5xx <= 0.4% (1m). if p95 > 180ms or 5xx > 0.8% rollback automatically.

metrics-bot: initial snapshot: p95=128ms p99=305ms 5xx=0.05% kvcache_hit=92% host-h2 cpu=76% host-h1 cpu=62%

liya: seeing a small tail on host-h2 traces (serialization spike ~240ms), no 5xx yet.

rory: sounds like we should reduce blast radius. propose `/adjust-canary embed-service --traffic=3% --hosts=h1` and pin to h1 while we investigate h2.

dev-bot: command processed: adjust-canary service=embed-service traffic=3% hosts=[h1]

metrics-bot: after adjustment: p95=122ms p99=300ms 5xx=0.04% kvcache_hit=92.3%

jen: good. rory, can you capture a GC/stack dump from h2 and share in the ticket? add a note to the changelog that h2 shows higher sys CPU during canary.

rory: will grab dumps and open a short ticket. tagging infra for host-h2 (cc @infra).

liya: holding canary at 3% pinned to h1. if staging patch for h2 (reduce heap or tweak threadpool) passes, schedule a single-host restart outside of the current change window? prefer to finish tonight if low risk.

jen: agree with holding. also bump the observability sampling for embed-route traces to 100% for next 10m so we get more tails.

metrics-bot: observability sampling increased to 100% for embed-route for 10m.

rory: opened ticket RN-427: "host-h2 tail latency investigation" with GC logs attached and a suggested JVM flag change.

liya: final state: canary=3% pinned host=h1, hold=true, rollback rules active. i'll update the release tracker and PMs. reopen thread when we resume ramp or if roll triggered.

dev-bot: canary state updated.

jen: thanks team, good containment.
